title: Chapter 739 - 739 Nine-Headed Flood Dragon; Attack!

Chapter 739 - 739 Nine-Headed Flood Dragon; Attack!

Chapter 739 - 739 Nine-Headed Flood Dragon; Attack!

739 Nine-Headed Flood Dragon; Attack!

In reality, Lin Fan wasn’t the only one who noticed this sci-fi looking spaceship.

The Four Seasons Universe First Elder and the others who were hiding in the void were also observing the flying ship and discussing it from time to time.

“He’s here!”

” What a terrifying aura. Is the ocean universe master inside too?”

“I wonder which experts they brought over.”

“Is there still that Star Lord Lin on Earth who can withstand it?”

“When do we make our move?”

….

From their conversation, it was not difficult to see their fear of the ocean universe.

This was normal…

After all, the ocean universe was an extremely famous and powerful universe.

In addition, over the years, the ocean universe had continuously eroded the Four Seasons Universe, making them feel invincible and unstoppable.

“Everyone, don’t worry. We’re a special force! Only when the ocean universe and earth are evenly matched can we launch a surprise attack and defeat the ocean universe in one fell swoop.”

“If we can’t do it, then we have to make other plans. After all, we are concerned with the entire Four Seasons Universe!”

“Now, let’s just wait quietly.”

Hearing this, everyone nodded in agreement, and their hearts calmed down a little.

….

At this moment, in the universe ship.

The nine-headed flood dragon’s nine pairs of eyes were staring intently at Earth.

In his field of vision, he only felt that the surface of the earth was covered by a thick spiritual energy that was as thick as a wall, and it condensed into countless roaring spiritual dragons.

“A small planet actually has such spiritual energy,” the nine-headed flood dragon said. Was there a protective array on the surface? Then destroy it first!”

His eyes swept to the side and said,” Fire the M1+ energy cannon.”

“Yes!” The murloc not far away said respectfully.”

Immediately, a thick cannon barrel slowly appeared from below the spaceship.

The muzzle of the cannon continued to gather energy, and then a dazzling energy wave flew out.

“Boom!”

The M1+ energy cannon that had always been successful bombarded the protective magic circle, but it did not cause a single ripple. It disappeared without a trace in an instant.

“Oh?” The nine-headed flood dragon said in surprise,” This defensive array…Interesting.”

” Use the S1+ energy cannon.”

“Yes, sir!” The murloc said respectfully again.

“Tsk!”

Another thick cannon appeared.

This time, it condensed into a ball of purple energy wave.

This energy wave was like the light of hell as it poured down.

“Boom!”

However, the energy shield on Earth’s surface still showed no signs of being damaged.

“Hmm?” The nine-headed flood dragon raised its eyebrows.

All the high-ranking officers in the spaceship were shocked.

One had to know that the S1+ energy cannon was a powerful weapon that could break through the defense of an Overlord-tier powerhouse.

With a single blast, even an Emperor would have to retreat.

But now, he could not break the protective array of a planet.

“Continue!” the nine-headed flood dragon said in a deep voice.”

“Boom!”

Another purple energy cannon shot out.

“Continuous attacks! Break it open!”

“Yes, sir!”

When he condensed the S1+ energy cannon again, a tall and handsome figure suddenly appeared in the void.

He was Lin Fan.

He saw…

Lin Fan raised his hand and pointed. A sharp sword energy shot out and instantly slashed at the S1 cannon.

Even if the S1+ energy cannon continued to attack for 100 years, it would definitely not be able to break through the Earth’s protective array.

However, there would be noise on Earth from time to time if they were attacked like this.

Lin Fan hated noise.

Therefore, he stepped forward.

“Little thief, how dare you destroy my turret! Universe master! I’m willing to go and behead him!” A man with a shark head said.

“Correct!” The nine-headed flood dragon said.

“Yes, sir!” The shark-headed man leaped out.

In the next moment, he appeared in the void a few thousand meters away from Lin Fan.

A scarlet energy spread rapidly from the shark-headed man’s body, quickly dyeing the entire void blood red.

The blood-red energy quickly gathered and vaguely formed countless ferocious blood sharks.

These blood sharks roared in unison, causing the void to tremble. Their might was tyrannical.

Then, like a sky full of sharp blood shark arrows, they shot towards Lin Fan with a powerful aura.

It was as though he wanted to tear Lin Fan and the Earth behind him into pieces.

Regarding this…

Lin Fan raised his hand and formed an energy sword.

He suddenly swung his sword.

“Whoosh!”

Instantly, tens of thousands of miles of space was covered by dense energy swords, and they all flew towards the blood sharks that filled the sky.

“Tsk!”

The long sword was successful in every way. It pierced through the blood sharks that filled the sky and instantly turned them into nothingness.

Then, like a torrential rain, they all smashed towards the shark-headed man.

“Puchi!”

The blood bloomed and dissipated in an instant, leaving no trace behind!

The shark-headed man was dead!

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Killed a King Stage Level 8 cultivator. Obtained 8 billion experience points.]

Even though he said so much, in the eyes of everyone in the universe ship, it was just a blink of an eye.

In the blink of an eye, an expert at the eighth level of the king level had fallen!

” What?!”

Many people cried out in horror.

They looked at Lin Fan cautiously.

The strength that Lin Fan had displayed was simply too shocking.

They had a guess in their hearts. Perhaps, Lin Fan was the one who killed Zach and the 10 golden battleships.

If that was the case, then he had to be even more careful.

The nine-headed flood dragon stared at Lin Fan and said,””Follow me to flatten 5901!”

The nine-headed flood dragon could sense how powerful Lin Fan was.

He understood that he had to do it personally.

Moreover, he had to end the battle quickly. Otherwise, it was very likely to bring unnecessary losses to the ocean universe.

“Yes!” Everyone shouted in unison.”

In the next moment, the nine-headed flood dragon and countless murlocs appeared in the void.

The nine-headed flood dragon stared at Lin Fan coldly and said,””You were the one who killed my Heavenly King Zach? Do you still have 10 gold warships?”

Lin Fan knew that the nine-headed flood dragon before him was the Ocean Universe Master.

However, he was not afraid.

That was because, when he had used the Eyes of Heaven, Lin Fan had already found out a few of the Nine Headed Flood Dragon’s weaknesses.

Although he couldn’t kill them instantly like he did with the others.

However, it would only take a little time.

“Not bad.” Lin Fan said calmly.

When Lin Fan killed the King level 8 expert, everyone had their own guesses.

At this moment, after hearing Lin Fan admit it, everyone couldn’t help but be shocked.

“Good, very good!” The nine heads of the flood dragon did not expect Lin Fan to agree to it.

The surrounding void continued to crack and collapse.

When the emperor was angry, the world would collapse.

The entire void and the entire universe seemed to be enveloped by nine huge flood dragon heads in an instant.

It was ferocious and terrifying to the extreme.

P.S. Welcome to my final book, Super Red Envelope Immortals.
